jei.gascraft.base_help: Times and costs shown are before upgrades, per operation or three-canister batch.
jei.gascraft.upgrade_help: Each Speed Upgrade multiplies speed and FE/t by 1.5. Each Efficiency Upgrade divides FE/t by 1.5. Time and FE/t round up.
jei.gascraft.generator_help: A Speed Upgrade halves fuel time and generates 64 FE/t internally, preserving FE per fuel. External output stays at 32 FE/t; a full buffer pauses fuel processing.
jei.gascraft.fermenter_help: Up to 64 starting items share one timer. Later additions wait for the next batch. Sleeping and unloaded chunks add no progress.
jei.gascraft.sky_help: Open sky above doubles fermentation speed, including at night or in rain.
jei.gascraft.transfer.cursor: Put down the item held by your cursor first.
jei.gascraft.transfer.wrong_machine: Open the matching machine to transfer this recipe.
jei.gascraft.transfer.locked: The current operation has locked its ingredients.

jei.gascraft.transfer.working_slots: No idle three-canister group is available.

gui.gascraft.machine.upgrade_lock: Upgrades are locked until processing is idle
gui.gascraft.machine.fuel_upgrade_lock: Upgrades are locked until the current fuel finishes burning
tooltip.gascraft.raid_outline: Hostile mobs glow while Raid Gas irritation remains
tooltip.gascraft.taco_chime_targets: Non-boss mobs lose all targets for 10 seconds
tooltip.gascraft.taco_chime_cloud: Active for 5 seconds, then fades over 2 seconds
tooltip.gascraft.gravity_gas.0: Slowness I and reduced jumping while inside.
tooltip.gascraft.gravity_gas.1: Mobs: Slowness II; pulled and held at the center.
tooltip.gascraft.gravity_gas.2: Wither and Ender Dragon: paralyzed while inside. Gas masks do not protect.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_sunburst.0: A blinding white flash: 0:00.5 hold, then 0:02 fade. Gas masks protect.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_sunburst.1: Mobs: stunned for 0:02 once; cannot target while inside.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_sunburst.2: Undead: paralyzed, unable to target, and burning while inside.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_sunburst.3: Undead bosses: 0:02 stun only. Other bosses are immune.
tooltip.gascraft.soul_ward_gas.0: Players: immune to undead melee and ranged attacks while inside.
tooltip.gascraft.soul_ward_gas.1: Undead, including the Wither: 12 spectral damage once per cloud; take 2× attack damage while inside.
tooltip.gascraft.soul_ward_gas.2: Spectral damage bypasses armor and shields. Gas masks allow the ward.
tooltip.gascraft.null_magic_gas.0: Continuously removes all positive and negative potion effects.
tooltip.gascraft.null_magic_gas.1: Blocks and interrupts magic and spellcasting while inside.
tooltip.gascraft.null_magic_gas.2: Physical attacks and non-potion gas controls continue. Gas masks do not protect.
tooltip.gascraft.voidrot_gas.0: Prevents teleportation and dimension travel while inside.
tooltip.gascraft.voidrot_gas.1: Affects players, mobs, and bosses. Gas masks do not protect.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_moonlight.0: Night Vision (3:00); at night also Speed I and Luck I (3:00).
tooltip.gascraft.misted_moonlight.1: Undead: Weakness I by day, Weakness II at night (3:00).
tooltip.gascraft.misted_moonlight.2: Other mobs: Speed I (3:00). Bosses are immune.
tooltip.gascraft.boogie_gas.0: Speed II and Jump Boost I; gas masks allow benefits.
tooltip.gascraft.boogie_gas.1: Mobs glow and dance: 0:03 dancing, 0:02 free, then 0:03 dancing.
tooltip.gascraft.boogie_gas.2: Dancing prevents targeting and attacks. All effects linger for 0:05.
tooltip.gascraft.boogie_gas.3: Bosses glow but do not dance.
tooltip.gascraft.boogie_gas.4: Last night a DJ saved my life
tooltip.gascraft.espresso_cloud.0: Speed I and Haste I while inside and for 2:00 afterward.
tooltip.gascraft.espresso_cloud.1: Then Weakness I (0:30). Re-exposure does not postpone a pending crash.
tooltip.gascraft.espresso_cloud.2: Mobs: Speed I inside, then Weakness I (0:30). Bosses are immune.
tooltip.gascraft.espresso_cloud.3: Gas masks allow the benefits and the crash.
tooltip.gascraft.chicken_gas.0: Speed II and Weakness I while inside. Gas masks prevent only Weakness.
tooltip.gascraft.chicken_gas.1: Mobs: Speed II; flee nearby players and cannot attack or target for 1:00.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_cologne.0: Luck I (3:00); take 2× damage from mobs while inside.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_cologne.1: Gas masks prevent vulnerability and allow Luck.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_cologne.2: Attack-capable mobs target the nearest mob or player while inside. Bosses are immune.
manual.gascraft.intro: A pocket guide to machines and gases. Use these links to choose a topic. Optional chains appear only when their ingredients are available.
manual.gascraft.basics: Combine a canister with a Grenade Diffuser to make a grenade. Hold Use to start the fuse; release to throw. The fuse keeps running while held.
manual.gascraft.protection: Masks prevent harmful exposure, but do not cure existing effects. Benefits pass through masks. Some physical effects bypass protection; check each gas.
manual.gascraft.automation.title: Automation and upgrades
manual.gascraft.automation: Open a machine's side panels to configure input/output and install upgrades. Speed upgrades shorten processing; efficiency upgrades reduce energy cost.
manual.gascraft.reagents.title: Reagents
manual.gascraft.reagent_types: Diamond: Sarin. Nether Star: Gravity. Ghast Tear: Soul Ward. Crying Obsidian: Voidrot. Reagent recipes require the Netherite Synthesizer.
manual.gascraft.reagent_switch: Spend or dump charges before changing reagents.
manual.gascraft.generator: Burns normal furnace fuels to generate energy. Can charge a Grenade Launcher in its charging slot while supplying adjacent machines.
manual.gascraft.powder_mixer: Combines powders and other ingredients in shaped recipes.
manual.gascraft.materials_kiln: Fires pellet composites into pellets. Also accepts normal furnace smelting recipes.
manual.gascraft.fermenter: Ferments whole stacks without power. Open sky doubles speed, even at night or in rain.
manual.gascraft.synthesizer: Processes three canisters at once. Add recipe liquids to its tank.
manual.gascraft.smoke: Provides visual cover without a status effect.
manual.gascraft.tear: Irritates eyes, blurs players' vision and slows movement. Ordinary mobs lose player targets. Variable linger.
manual.gascraft.pulmonary: Depletes gas breath, then causes suffocation damage. Leaving stops new damage and allows breath to recover.
manual.gascraft.mustard: Slows movement and disrupts ordinary mobs' targeting and movement. Damage can linger for 0:05 after exhausted-breath exposure; irritation lasts until it clears.
manual.gascraft.sarin: Nerve exposure builds with dose and causes increasing damage until the sickness clears. Crouching suspends new sickness while gas breath remains.
manual.gascraft.raid: Tear Gas effects, plus outlines on hostile mobs. Effects can linger after leaving.
manual.gascraft.regeneration: Regeneration VI in the cloud for 0:20, with 0:10 linger.
manual.gascraft.healing: One Instant Health V pulse when the fuse expires: up to 64 health restored, or 96 base damage to undead. Masks allow healing but protect undead from the harmful inversion.
manual.gascraft.meat: Feeds players through a gaseous food source. Masks allow this beneficial effect. This gas is invisible.
manual.gascraft.poison.title: Poison I / II / III
manual.gascraft.poison: Applies the named Poison level while exposed. The gas-applied Poison lasts 0:01 after the last exposure. Normal poison immunities apply.
manual.gascraft.napalm: After 0:05, one 18 base-damage blast ignites targets for 0:05 and knocks them back. Masks do not protect. Black smoke follows, then fades.
manual.gascraft.stun: A brief flash on release, with paralysis while inside for 0:20. Masks protect. Paralysis has no holdover after leaving; the white cloud then fades for 0:03.
manual.gascraft.tetro.title: Tetrodotoxin I / II / III
manual.gascraft.tetro: Immediate paralysis for 0:05, then one varying damage hit. Armor and shields are bypassed. Wither and Ender Dragon are eligible. Masks protect.
manual.gascraft.field: These fields affect the full reachable area immediately for 0:08. Expansion and fading are visual. Leaving ends effects unless a linger is listed.
manual.gascraft.gravity: Players: Slowness I and half jump strength. Mobs: Slowness II; pulled and held near the center. Wither and Ender Dragon are paralyzed. Masks do not protect.
manual.gascraft.sunburst: Players: white flash for 0:00.5, fading over 0:02; once per cloud. Masks protect. Ordinary mobs: one 0:02 stun, then targeting blocked while inside.
manual.gascraft.sunburst_undead: Undead: paralyzed, unable to target and burning while inside. Helmets do not protect. Undead bosses: 0:02 stun only. Other bosses are immune.
manual.gascraft.soul: Players: immune to undead attacks inside, even with masks. Undead, including Wither: one 12-damage spectral hit (bypasses armor and shields); take double attack damage inside.
manual.gascraft.null: Continuously removes all potion effects. Blocks spells and interrupts unfinished casts for players, mobs and bosses. Masks do not protect. Removed effects do not return.
manual.gascraft.void: Blocks teleportation and dimension travel for players, mobs and bosses while inside. Death and respawn are unaffected. Masks do not protect.
manual.gascraft.moon: Players: Night Vision for 3:00; at night also Speed I and Luck I for 3:00. Undead: Weakness I by day or II at night for 3:00. Other mobs: Speed I for 3:00. Bosses are immune. Masks allow benefits.
manual.gascraft.boogie: Players: Speed II, Jump Boost I, and Glowing. Mobs glow and dance 0:03, 0:02 free, then 0:03 dancing. All effects linger 0:05. Bosses glow only. Masks allow benefits.
manual.gascraft.espresso: Players: Speed I and Haste I with 2:00 linger, then Weakness I for 0:30. Mobs: Speed I only inside, then Weakness I for 0:30. Masks allow benefits and the crash.
manual.gascraft.chicken: Players: Speed II and Weakness I only inside. Masks prevent only Weakness. Ordinary mobs gain Speed II and flee the nearest player within 64 blocks; no targeting or attacks. Fear lingers for 1:00.
manual.gascraft.cologne: Players: Luck I 3:00; double damage from mobs inside. Masks block vulnerability. Mobs target the nearest mob or player, retargeting when it disappears.
manual.gascraft.taco: Nausea lasts 0:10 after exposure. Mobs cannot target for 0:10. Bosses can gain Nausea. Masks protect.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_sunburst.summary: Blinds players, stuns mobs and burns undead.
tooltip.gascraft.soul_ward_gas.summary: Protects against undead and makes them vulnerable.
tooltip.gascraft.null_magic_gas.summary: Clears potion effects and blocks spellcasting.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_moonlight.summar: Night Vision and moonlit benefits; weakens undead.
tooltip.gascraft.boogie_gas.summary: Boosts movement and makes mobs dance.
tooltip.gascraft.espresso_cloud.summary: Speed and Haste, followed by a weakness crash.
tooltip.gascraft.chicken_gas.summary: Boosts speed and makes mobs flee.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_cologne.summary: Grants Luck, adds vulnerability and turns mobs on each other.
manual.gascraft.default_recipes: Illustrated recipes show built-in defaults. Packs may change recipes. Hover over ingredients to see their names.
manual.gascraft.void_pulse: Teleports living targets once to a safe random spot up to 64 blocks away. Masks do not protect. Without a safe spot, targets stay put. Voidrot prevents the teleport.
manual.gascraft.disclaimer: Modpack content may differ from this manual.
tooltip.gascraft.misted_cologne.flavor: Sir, put down the Drakkar Noir
manual.gascraft.meal_fart: Fart releases Taco Chime Gas here. The cloud stays there.
tooltip.gascraft.grenade_belt: Allows stacking 4 grenades per inventory slot
tooltip.gascraft.shrinking_gas.summary: Shrinks creatures and grants Speed I.
manual.gascraft.shrinking.1: One invisible pulse lasting 10:00. Players become half size. Mobs use their baby form when available, otherwise half size. Health is unchanged.
manual.gascraft.shrinking.2: Deals 0.75× normal attack damage, including projectiles and spells. Grants Speed I. Masks protect.
tooltip.gascraft.enlarging_gas.summary: Enlarges creatures and grants combat benefits.
manual.gascraft.enlarging.1: One invisible pulse lasting 10:00, making creatures 3× their normal size. Requires enough space. Masks allow benefits.
manual.gascraft.enlarging.2: Mobs gain 2× current and maximum health and deal 2× attack damage, including ranged attacks. Players gain 10 gold absorption hearts and Strength X.
manual.gascraft.enlarging.3: The opposite gas replaces the package.
manual.gascraft.square_any_order: Any order in a filled 2×2 square
tooltip.gascraft.taco_chime_gas.flavor: Make a Run for the Lavatory
